notes: SUMMARY: Highly-regulated fintech using heavy ML for post-trade surveillance. Wants private/VPC deployment and strict audit trails. Initially enthusiastic about cost optimizations but derailed by integration work.
Key friction points called out repeatedly:
- SDK gaps: Java/Scala helpers missing (they run Kotlin microservices). Engineers said 'we can't justify ship time to wrap every call we need.'
- Auth complexity: need SAML + Okta SCIM provisioning + example SSO flows. Security team asked for step-by-step SAML docs and assertion samples — flagged as high blocker.

- Observability/tracing: team requires token-level latency breakdowns and a Datadog/Lightstep hook to correlate traces with request IDs. Current runtime metrics are good but not surfaced in their APM.
- Audit & retention: retention controls and immutable audit logs required for compliance; our docs were generic and security asked for concrete retention SLAs and export formats.
What we delivered: POC cluster, sample model config, cost estimates, security FAQ draft, token-level cost breakdown spreadsheet.
Customer feedback (paraphrase): 'Your infra looks solid, but integrating it into our platform will eat multiple sprints — vendor X shipped ready-made SDKs and APM hooks.'
Sales posture: Originally realistic ARR $500k-$1M but procurement freeze + competitor ease-of-integration pushed deal out of near-term funnel.
Support escalations: INF-3124 opened for Java SDK request; engineering scoped small SDK sprint but budget/priority blocked implementation.
Quote from engineering lead: 'If we can get a packaged Java client and a sample Datadog integration in two weeks, we can re-prioritize this.'

Internal notes/actions: offered 2-week engineering pilot + billable integration work at fixed cost; offered security deep-dive with Redwood SecOps; legal requested data residency appendix. All offers noted in Drive links.

Next recommended approach: 1) Ship minimal Java SDK (client + auth helper) and Datadog traces example as a short-term unblock; 2) Provide concrete audit log export sample and retention matrix; 3) Re-engage after budget cycle (target 2026-04).
Current disposition: Stalled/procurement pause. Marked as churn risk but keep as re-engage 2026-Q2.
